[[File:Tftreaty.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Sentepeth Findos]] in Koto-Si, signing the treaty dissolving the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].]]
'''Koto-Si''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> From here it was reported that Acting [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] signed a [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] that gave the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] direct control over the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] assets and resources, thus effectively dissolving the trade organization.
